title: info
summary: Prints engine self-info: version, build date, license (MIT), tree-sitter details, and capabilities
intro: Read this when you need to know which build of drag-lint you are running, or want a script to check the version. It prints the version, build date, license and capabilities, and with --json --db it also tells you whether an index is stale for this engine.

surfaces.usage: drag-lint info [--json] [--db <file.sqlite>]... (engine self-info: product/extractor/resolver versions, build date, MIT, tree-sitter + capabilities; read-only)
help: drag-lint info [--json] [--db <file.sqlite>]...      (engine self-info: product/extractor/resolver versions, build date, MIT, tree-sitter + capabilities; read-only)
each --db adds an `indexes` entry (--json): stored fingerprints, indexer_stale / resolver_stale, a verdict
(current | resolve-owed | library-resolve-owed | reparse-owed | index-newer | missing | unreadable) and the remedy. Keyed lookups, no COUNT.
text form: one "index: <path>  verdict: <v>" line per --db, then "  remedy: ..." when one is owed.

library-resolve-owed: the DB was resolved without its platform library (marker schema_meta library_resolve_state = pending); --json adds library_resolve {state, reason, since_unix, library_state}, the text form a library_resolve line.

questions.ask: Which engine version and build is this?
What does this engine report as JSON, including index versions?

notes: issued by the plugin from StartBackgroundSelfInfoFetch (DragLint.Plugin.About.pas)
